outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed in left_ego_image at frame 0. The robot approaches and aligns with its handle (frames 30–86, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward: increasing extension is visible at frames 108–126 in image and left_ego_image. The gripper releases and withdraws at frames 129–150, leaving the drawer visibly open through frame 188 in left_ego_image. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated objects is established.
